name: @shepherd/ui
description: The Shepherd primitive set. PUBLIC: an extension imports this so its view looks native and re-themes for free.
//exports: Two entries and no more. `.` is the components; `./styles.css` is the component tier of custom properties, which a page must load once (it is not injected — a stylesheet that mounts itself is a stylesheet whose order nobody controls).
//peerDependencies: React is the HOST's, not ours. Two copies of react in one page is two reconcilers, and the hook errors it produces name a file that is not the problem.
